name: 3rd International Seminar on Trade (ISoT)
organizer: CESifo with JIE, LMU Munich, ifo Institute, CRC, CEPR and the World Bank; organizers Costas Arkolakis, Carsten Eckel, Lisandra Flach, Gianmarco Ottaviano, Claudia Steinwender, Daria Taglioni
deadline_note: Stated as 11:59 PM EST on 10 January 2027 (4:59 AM GMT / 5:59 CET on 11 January 2027)
submission_requirements: PDF of the paper; empirical, theoretical and quantitative international trade (related fields with a significant trade component welcome); papers must not be under consideration at another journal; CESifo reimburses economy travel for one speaker per paper and covers accommodation; optional DFG/IDoL pre-conference workshop on the afternoon of 19 May
notification_date: Mid-February 2027 (only authors of accepted papers contacted)
journal: Papers may be considered for a Journal of International Economics special issue (guest editors Kalina Manova and Pol Antràs)
